svg.title: CortexProbe: estimation and held-out validation
svg.desc: Matched synthetic aperture masks, responses, and groups branch into a full-data Gaussian fit and independent training-fold refits. Both paths use candidate search and bounded refinement, solving amplitude and baseline at each geometry. Held-out prediction freezes all five fitted parameters. The evidence strip reports measured recovery error, noise-only acceptance, and interval coverage under the stated synthetic conditions.
